Class Enemy

java.lang.Object
entity.Entity
entity.enemy.Enemy
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameObject
public class Enemy extends Entity
Represents a single enemy unit in the game world.

Enemies are created in two steps:

  1. A template instance is added to EnemySpawner.addEnemyToSpawner(Enemy) with stats but no world position.
  2. The spawner clones the template via the Enemy(Enemy, double, double) copy constructor to produce a positioned instance that is added to the live inGameEnemyList.

Movement

Each frame the enemy steers directly toward the player's world position. If a knockback timer is active the enemy is pushed in the opposite direction instead; if a stun timer is active it stands still.

Damage

Weapons call takeDamage(double, double, double, Color) to reduce HP, apply stun / knockback, and spawn a floating damage-text VFX.

  • Constructor Details

    • Enemy

      public Enemy(String name, int speed, double maxHP, boolean collisionOn, boolean movable)
      Template constructor — creates an enemy with stats but no map position.

      Instances created with this constructor are stored in the spawner's list and are never added to the live game world directly.

      Parameters:
      name - logical name; must match the sprite resource filename (e.g. "slime" → slime.png)
      speed - movement speed in pixels per second
      maxHP - maximum (and starting) hit points
      collisionOn - whether the enemy should check tile collisions
      movable - whether the enemy should chase the player

    • Enemy

      public Enemy(Enemy enemy, double mapX, double mapY)
      Spawner copy constructor — creates a positioned, play-ready enemy from a template.
      Parameters:
      enemy - the template enemy to copy stats from
      mapX - initial world-space X coordinate
      mapY - initial world-space Y coordinate

  • Method Details

    • update

      public void update(double accumulateDeltaTime, double characterMapX, double characterMapY)
      Advances the enemy's state by one frame.

      Steps:

      1. Decrement stun / knockback timers.
      2. Apply tile collision to prevent walking through walls.
      3. If knocked back, move away from the player; if stunned, stay still; otherwise move toward the player.
      4. Recompute the hitbox at the new position.
      5. Recalculate the normalised direction vector toward the player.
      Parameters:
      accumulateDeltaTime - seconds since the last frame
      characterMapX - player's current world X
      characterMapY - player's current world Y

    • takeDamage

      public void takeDamage(double amount, double stuntDuration, double knockbackDuration, javafx.scene.paint.Color color)
      Applies damage to this enemy and triggers stun / knockback effects.

      HP is always reduced regardless of any timer. Stun and knockback timers are only extended if the new duration would be longer than the remaining time (so strong hits override weaker ongoing effects). A floating damage-text VFX is always spawned.

      Parameters:
      amount - raw damage to subtract
      stuntDuration - seconds the enemy should be stunned (0 = none)
      knockbackDuration - seconds the enemy should be knocked back (0 = none)
      color - colour of the floating damage number
